summary: For Marketing Intern roles in Mumbai, the sample holds 51 postings with a median age of 10 days, and the outlook is competitive. Advertised pay has a median of 150,000 INR/year across 28 postings, with pay periods assumed. The sample was broadened twice in titles, radius, recency and category.
